description: Read a payment record from its link: the bank reports on a paid transfer, shared by its owner with whoever holds the link. Any key can read a record it has the link to, from any account. A link the owner replaced, or one that never existed, is not found. Reading changes nothing and is not counted as a visit to the record.

record_token.description: The token at the end of a payment record link (/p/...), or the whole link.

name: get_payment_record
title: Get a payment record
